payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped PgSqlDriver over the FR-118 SqlDriver seam (?->$n, param normalization, BIGINT->number, rowCount->changes/RETURNING->lastInsertRowid, per-client transactions) + async createPgSqlDriver(). Verified against real Postgres 16: object/stream/idempotency stores run unmodified (their ON CONFLICT/RETURNING SQL is already dialect-neutral). Exported from @fricken/server; CI test:pg widened with the conformance suite. Full repo green (1077). Full createFrickServer-on-PG deferred to FR-121 (needs async construction + porting devtools/FTS/platform-events off rawDb).
